This '''warehouse''' was located on a [[Unidentified deserted moon|deserted moon]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this abandoned warehouse contained a contingent of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], along with their [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]].<ref name="REP" />
